log: FNOL rec'd by phone. Insd Marcus Okonkwo rear-ended at stop light in 2022 Honda Accord EX (VIN ...4217). Low speed, damage to rear bumper and trunk lid. No injuries, no tow. TP driver cited per insd. Collision coverage confirmed, $500 deductible.
Rental endorsement on policy. Authorized rental for duration of repairs. Assigned Apex Appraisal Services for inspection.
Apex inspection completed. Damage consistent with rear-end impact. Repair estimate $3,160.25 gross. Appraisal fee $350 approved.
Recorded statement taken from insd; matches FNOL. Liability clear, TP 100% at fault. Flagged for subrogation against TP carrier for paid amount plus insd deductible.
Repairs complete per shop. Insd signed release. Net payable after $500 deductible: $2,660.25.
Indemnity payment $2,660.25 issued to insd. Insd left voicemail confirming receipt and asking about deductible recovery; called back and explained subro process. Closing pending subro.

FNOL. Insd Patricia Carmichael (2023 Toyota Highlander XLE) struck claimant vehicle while merging near Plano. High-speed impact. Clmt Denise R. Varga transported by ambulance. Clmt vehicle appears total loss.

Contacted insd. Admits she did not see clmt vehicle when merging; says clmt was speeding. Liability: insd presumed majority at fault, comparative negligence possible. Apex Appraisal assigned for insd vehicle.
Apex Appraisal inspected insd vehicle. Clmt alleges cervical and lumbar injuries. Clmt represented by Ramirez Law Group (Elena Ramirez). LOR received, all contact through counsel.
Reserves set: $150,000 BI / $38,500 PD. Clmt vehicle confirmed total loss. Requested medical records via counsel.
Rec'd clmt medical records through 3/20 (ER, ortho, progress notes). Clmt in ongoing PT for neck and low back. Reserves unchanged; diary 60 days.
Clmt counsel advises treatment completed 6/1. Demand package to follow. No settlement discussion yet.
Suit filed in Collin County (served on insd 6/22). Defense assigned to Nguyen & Associates (Harold V. Nguyen). Sent combined medical/legal file to defense counsel.
Policy-limits demand rec'd from Ramirez Law: $225,000 on behalf of Denise R. Varga. Medical specials $74,210. Demand open 30 days. Diary set to respond well before expiry.
Claim evaluation done with defense counsel. Specials $74,210, soft-tissue injuries, comparative fault arguable. Recommend settlement range $120k-$140k. Requesting authority for $132,500.
Reviewed evaluation and defense counsel input. Settlement authority granted up to $132,500. Proceed with offer.

Offered $132,500 to Ramirez Law without admission of liability. Counsel accepted verbally. Release of all claims sent; payment held pending signed release. Ledger: indemnity $132,500 negotiated, pending release.

FNOL rec'd 3 days after loss. Insd Angela Foster reports deer strike on 4/19 on Rural Rte 9 near Grover, NC, 2021 Subaru Outback Premium. Single vehicle, no witnesses, no police report filed. Insd says she delayed reporting because the car was still drivable.
Apex Appraisal inspected vehicle. Shop estimate $7,381. Appraiser notes front damage pattern and impact height look more like a fixed object than an animal; no hair or tissue found.
Late report + no witnesses + damage inconsistent with deer strike. Referred to SIU. Holding indemnity payment pending SIU review.
SIU file opened. Field inspection of vehicle and reported loss location. Photo log SIU-2026-0771 created (kept in SIU file, not the general claim folder).
Initial SIU review complete: reported deer strike not consistent with observed damage. Recommend examination under oath before any payment. Sent findings and photo log to Marcus Hale.
Reservation of rights letter sent to insd. Called insd to explain the EUO request; insd agreed to attend.
EUO scheduled for 2026-05-12. Only payment to date is the $350 Apex appraisal fee. Diary for EUO.
